caseConfiguration.q0Fixture: unchanged Q0 domain, 32 internal iterations per isolated worker; duration is its per-operation mean
caseConfiguration.realEncoders: 8 fixed PNG plus 8 fixed SVG; same oxipng/SVGO versions, configuration and output policy for both variants

resourceScope: worker parent plus all visible descendants, including encoder grandchildren; sampler and ps excluded
sampling: ps RSS KiB and lifetime-average %CPU summed across tree; sampled maxima, 15ms wait plus ps duration; short-lived peaks may be missed; same scope and cadence for both variants
